{{Top|leg}}
A '''torpedo launcher''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]]-mounted projectile launcher, specifically designed to be fired [[Water/Legends|underwater]]. The ''[[Lost Reef]]'', a [[DeepWater-class light freighter|''DeepWater''-class light freighter]], was armed with a bank of four concealed torpedo launchers.<ref name="SS">''[[Stock Ships]]''</ref>
